data.resolved_value:
Everytime Giyu casts a spell after another spell, he does extra 0.5x agi damage at 1-st stack and 0.4 with each next, stacking up to 2.5x agi lasting for 12 seconds. he loose 2 stack every timer end.
Also Giyu can make combine his abilities: 
[Q+E] combo causes each E slash to stun for 0.1 sec.
[Q+W] combo causes the W to push further back.
[W+E] combo causes E to slow.
[W+Q] combo causes Q to stun for 1.5 sec instead of 1.
